title: Project overview
description: One isolated GitHub Project V2. Native issue types, board Status and current Iteration; observation history is not event history.

list.name: currentSprint
list.label: Current Sprint
list.query:
WITH active_iteration AS (
 SELECT it->>'id' AS id, it->>'title' AS title, (it->>'startDate')::date AS start_date, (it->>'duration')::int AS duration
 FROM analytics.project_current p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.snapshot->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(f->'configuration'->'iterations','[]'::jsonb) || COALESCE(f->'configuration'->'completedIterations','[]'::jsonb)) it
 WHERE f->>'name'='Sprint' AND (it->>'startDate')::date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date < (it->>'startDate')::date + (it->>'duration')::int
) SELECT title || ' · ' || to_char(start_date,'DD.MM') || '–' || to_char(start_date+duration-1,'DD.MM.YYYY') AS __text, id AS __value FROM active_iteration ORDER BY start_date

options.content: **Тип — GitHub Issue Type; Status — поле доски.** PR и черновики отдельно. Без типа ≠ история или эпик. Sprint — даты Iteration (UTC). Суточный снимок, не прогноз.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_type='ISSUE' AND issue_type='Feature')::int AS "Feature",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_type='ISSUE' AND issue_type='Debt')::int AS "Debt",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_type='ISSUE' AND issue_type IS NULL)::int AS "Issues без типа",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_type='PULL_REQUEST')::int AS "PR",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE')::int AS "Черновики",
count(*)::int AS "Всего карточек"
FROM analytics.items WHERE present AND NOT archived

panels.title: Status Issues · PR и черновики исключены
panels.description: Авторитетное поле — Status доски, а не OPEN/CLOSED issue. Сегменты показывают нативный Issue Type. Учитываются присутствующие неархивные карточки.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(f.display_value,'Без Status') AS "Status",
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_type='Feature')::int AS "Feature",
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_type='Debt')::int AS "Debt",
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_type IS NULL)::int AS "Без Issue Type",
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_type IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_type NOT IN ('Feature','Debt'))::int AS "Другой Issue Type"
 FROM analytics.items i LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields f ON f.item_id=i.item_id AND f.field_name='Status'
 WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.item_type='ISSUE'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(f.display_value,'Без Status') WHEN 'Todo' THEN 1 WHEN 'In Progress' THEN 2 WHEN 'Need review' THEN 3 WHEN 'Done' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Текущий Sprint: ${currentSprint:text}
panels.description: Все присутствующие неархивные карточки активной Iteration. Граница: startDate ≤ дата UTC < startDate + duration. Типы не смешиваются в показатель историй.

targets.rawSql:
WITH active_iteration AS (
 SELECT it->>'id' AS id, it->>'title' AS title, (it->>'startDate')::date AS start_date, (it->>'duration')::int AS duration
 FROM analytics.project_current p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.snapshot->'fields') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(f->'configuration'->'iterations','[]'::jsonb) || COALESCE(f->'configuration'->'completedIterations','[]'::jsonb)) it
 WHERE f->>'name'='Sprint' AND (it->>'startDate')::date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date < (it->>'startDate')::date + (it->>'duration')::int
), rows AS (
 SELECT CASE i.item_type WHEN 'PULL_REQUEST' THEN 'PR' WHEN 'DRAFT_ISSUE' THEN 'Черновик' ELSE COALESCE(i.issue_type,'Issue без типа') END AS "Тип",
 i.title AS "Карточка", COALESCE(f.display_value,'Без Status') AS "Status", i.url AS "URL"
 FROM analytics.items i JOIN analytics.item_iterations it ON it.item_id=i.item_id AND it.field_name='Sprint'
 JOIN active_iteration a ON a.id=it.iteration_id
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields f ON f.item_id=i.item_id AND f.field_name='Status'
 WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived
)
SELECT * FROM rows
UNION ALL SELECT '—',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_iteration) THEN 'В активном Sprint нет карточек' ELSE 'Нет активного Sprint по датам Iteration' END,'—',NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rows)
ORDER BY "Тип","Status","Карточка"

panels.title: Синхронизация · полный снимок раз в сутки
panels.description: История хранит время наблюдения, а не точное время переходов. Первая загрузка не позволяет строить прогнозы. Обновления и исчезновения фиксируются только после полной успешной выборки.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM analytics.sync_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1),
 successful AS (SELECT * FROM analytics.sync_runs WHERE status='complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1)
 SELECT CASE latest.status WHEN 'complete' THEN 'Успешно' WHEN 'running' THEN 'В процессе' ELSE 'Ошибка' END AS "Последняя попытка",
 (extract(epoch FROM successful.completed_at)*1000)::double precision AS "Последний успех · UTC",
 successful.item_count AS "Карточек в полном снимке",
 round(extract(epoch FROM (now()-successful.completed_at))/60)::int AS "Возраст, мин"
 FROM latest FULL JOIN successful ON true
